scope: COV-017au: full/short action-reason and purpose endings 느라고/느라, honorific-only prefinal license, represented classes and polite 요.

primary_source_review.summary: NIKL 2014 grammar research treats 느라 as a short form of 느라고, requires verbal attachment, and excludes 었/겠. It also discusses contextual subject, mood and meaning restrictions, including exceptions; token morphology does not decide these.
NIKL accepts both 주느라요 and 주느라고요.
NIKL rejects adjective 바쁘다 with 느라 and recommends the distinct causal ending 어서; dictionary lexical adjectives receive a scoped conflict.

raw_judgments.review_status: Agent-authored, source-backed judgments; independent Korean-language review pending. Not a precision benchmark.

inventory_scope: Two ending entries receive scoped reviews. Queue totals: 321 scoped, 393 unreviewed and one unresolved gap.

validation.browser: passed persistent suite: 96 raw and 22 policy API cases; nine selected breakdown paths, source navigation, CLI/export parity; desktop/mobile screenshots inspected

limitations: Source-backed authored judgments need independent Korean-language review and do not measure linguistic precision.
Purpose versus cause, argument identity, volition and subsequent clause mood require context. Natural-phenomenon examples in the primary research preclude a blanket same-subject rule.
Dictionary-free unknown lexical heads remain hypotheses. The dictionary rule checks each adjective entry only at its own ending, preserving verb homonyms and unknown auxiliary POS.
Known inherited auxiliary adjective classes reject this verbal ending. Broader inheritance from ambiguous lexical dictionary entries remains COV-019.
Only polite 요 is newly licensed after 느라. Existing 느라고 topic/additive paths are retained; wider short-form outer-particle licenses remain COV-018.
GSD 떠시느라 is still annotated 떠+시+느라 and matched as 떠다, while the separate rule reading 떨다 is tested. Matching this noisy gold is not proof of lexical accuracy.
The complete fixtures retain unrelated mismatches: KAIST 동그래진다 expects 동그렇다 + 지다; GSD 늘릴라고 lacks 늘리다 (tracked as COV-017av). No source gold is rewritten.

Novel candidates are unchanged; six records gain provenance only. Raw focused comparison removals are individually recorded with class/prefinal reasons; arbitrary alternative lexical roots are not declared correct.
